outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution micrographs (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a quantitative summary plot.
Panel B shows super-resolution micrographs analogous to A, not a summary plot.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell with mean ± SEM overlaid on visible individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes with mean ± SEM overlaid on visible individual gray dots for each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of the proportion of clustered molecules per cell with mean ± SEM overlaid on visible individual gray dots per cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows sptPALM micrographs/trajectory overlays, not a summary plot.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement over time; both plot types are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and kymographs (micrograph-type visualizations), not a summary statistic plot.
